title: Backfill missed G5 readings
symptom: After switching from the Dexcom Share app to xDrip+, missed readings are not backfilled when the phone is out of range of the sensor, which is useful for reviewing trends.
cause: Back filling is not supported in the raw data collection mode which xDrip uses.
fix: Enable OB1 collector and native algorithm in the debug settings.
evidence_quote: This now works if you enable OB1 collector and native algorithm in the debug settings.
